27:t_2:27.en:
$$恵理$$
「...Fine. But before that, you have to get promoted to the next year first. Good luck with the remedial classes.」

27:t_2:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「Ma'am...! The entire Volunteer Club intends to tackle it as one.」

27:t_2:29.en:
$$恵理$$
「We can think about what comes after graduation again, slowly. Well then...」

27:t_2:32.en:
$$宗介$$
「What's wrong, $$千鳥$$? You have the same look on your face as Ms. $$神楽坂$$.」

27:t_2:33.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A career plan is... about what comes after you graduate, you know.」

27:t_2:34.en:
$$宗介$$
「I can't know about something that far off.」

27:t_2:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「That is why I've decided to cherish what is right in front of me.」

27:t_2:36.en:
$$かなめ$$
「That's what graduation is to you...」

27:t_2:37.en:
$$宗介$$
「Correct. I will graduate from $$陣代高校$$ together with the Volunteer Club and my classmates in Class 2-4.」

27:t_2:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「Alongside the fight against the $$新地球皇国$$, that is what I should cherish.」

27:t_2:40.en:
$$宗介$$
「Of course, $$千鳥$$... You are with me, too.」

27:t_2:41.en:
$$かなめ$$
「W-What's that... Saying it out of the blue, like it just occurred to you.」

27:t_2:42.en:
$$宗介$$
「Your face is red. Did you catch a cold or something?」

27:t_2:43.en:
$$かなめ$$
「...Still the same in that department, too, huh.」

27:t_2:45.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Well then, it's a promise. Let's be sure to graduate together, okay?」

27:t_2:46.en:
$$宗介$$
「Together with showing you the sea, that makes two promises.」

27:t_2:49.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Then those two promises... Keep them, no matter what.」

27:t_2:53.en:
$n
「Nobody could get between those two right now.」

27:t_2:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It's nothing. Well... My teaching practice is nearly over too, so I have to do my best.」

27:t_2:58.en:
$n
(This unfathomable anxiety clinging to my mind... Is Miss $$スズネ$$ feeling it too...?)

27:t_2:59.en:
$n
(What on earth is this...? Is it fear of the $$新地球皇国$$, or fear of the $$レイライン$$ running out of control...?)

27:t_2:62.en:
$$甲児$$
「Hurry up and go get $$宗介$$. Since $$マオ$$ is actually treating us to ramen, let's go before she changes her mind.」

27:t_2:63.en:
$$アルト$$
「Just so you know, you're getting yours without garlic.」

27:t_2:64.en:
$n
「Why? Galaxy Ramen is all about the simmered egg and garlic, isn't it?」

27:t_2:65.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「You sure? You're going to see Nurse after this.」

27:t_2:66.en:
$n
「...I'll drink milk, though. Is that no good?」

27:t_2:67.en:
$$クラン$$
「Of course it's no good! What do you take a long-awaited rendezvous between lovers for!?」

27:t_2:68.en:
$$クラン$$
「For that matter, this unit has far too many men who don't understand a woman's heart!」

27:t_2:70.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「$$クラン$$ is right, $n. You need to learn a lot more about a woman's heart.」

27:t_2:71.en:
$n
「$$ミシェル$$... I'm the one taking the brunt of your frustration here...」

27:t_2:73.en:
$n
「N-No...! Nothing that would add fuel to the fire!」

27:t_2:74.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Heh heh... Good etiquette before meeting a woman. By the way, I have no plans to meet anyone, so I'll put in plenty.」

27:t_2:76.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Not at all! I'll do my best to live even on my own.」

27:t_2:77.en:
$n
「...I give up. I'll follow Miss $$スズネ$$'s example and live positively.」

27:t_2:80.en:
$$スズネ$$
(To this anxiety... and to fate, too...)

27:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$宗介$$. Your destruction of the $$ベヘモス$$ was magnificent.」

27:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well, from our combat experience in $$お台場$$, the weakness of that big lug was obvious, so I'm sure it was a cakewalk for you.」

27:t_10:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「...That weakness had been completely fixed.」

27:t_10:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「I aimed for the crotch first, too, but armor had been added there. There's no way to beat it except brute force.」

27:t_10:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Even so, you were really into it today. You've also gotten better at turning the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$'s power into attacks.」

27:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your elevated state of mind back then produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

27:t_10:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Still a miser... or rather, a Chip-miser, as always...」

27:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Because that is the thing I must protect!」

27:t_10:18.en:
$$アル$$
「Signal sensitivity is good. There are no problems with communication.」

27:t_10:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've obtained the item you requested, so I'll come by to install it later.」

27:t_10:20.en:
$$アル$$
「Thank you. With the 《$$ＵＮ$$》 lines incomplete due to the $$新地球皇国$$, the information I can obtain is limited.」

27:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, dictionaries and world news are one thing, but to want a slang dictionary and even movies and anime...」

27:t_10:22.en:
$$アル$$
「The Sergeant told me I have a small vocabulary and a rigid mind. I need them to overcome this weakness.」

27:t_10:23.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「So you want to make $$宗介$$ say 'Gyafun,' do you? In that case, I, $$ＡＧ$$, will cooperate.」

27:t_10:24.en:
$$アル$$
「Educational message. Please define the meaning of 'Gyafun.'」

27:t_10:25.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You'll have to learn that yourself from here on. For now, let's prepare information on the fields he's weak in.」

27:t_10:26.en:
$$アル$$
「What fields is the Sergeant weak in?」

27:t_10:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Precisely, romance and humor. Let us master this field, Al.」

27:t_10:28.en:
$$アル$$
「Thank you. Is your cooperation like this out of a sense of kinship with me, a fellow artificial intelligence?」

27:t_10:29.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no... I have great expectations of you, Al.」

27:t_10:31.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. When that day comes, I will collect my fee for the cooperation.」

神楽坂.evidence: Eri Kagurazaka's family name (glossary 神楽坂恵理 = Eri Kagurazaka); Sousuke says 神楽坂先生 for Eri in t_2:32

千鳥.evidence: Kaname Chidori's surname (glossary 千鳥かなめ = Kaname Chidori); Sousuke addresses her as Chidori; same token used in dlg_2004_00

27:t_2:41: 急に思い出したように has no stated subject/object; rendered 'out of the blue, like it just occurred to you'
27:t_2:34/36: Kaname's 'それが卒業...' (t_2:36) has no stated subject; rendered 'That's what graduation is to you...'
27:t_2:74: 'put in plenty' (たっぷり入れる) keeps the object (garlic) unstated as in the Japanese
uncertain: 27:t_2:65: ナースさん is a plain word here (no 《》 link; glossary lists Nurse-san as proposed keyword); written 'Nurse' without -san
27:t_2:69: 先輩 rendered 'Senior Klan' (no honorific suffix per style guide)
27:t_2:71: お前の八つ当たり taken literally as Michel's venting ('your frustration') even though Klan is the one shouting
27:t_10:23: ギャフンと言わせる rendered with 'Gyafun' kept literal because Al asks for its definition in t_10:24
27:t_10:10: １００ＺのＺチップ rendered 'Z-Chips worth 100 Z'; Lambda Driver written as plain English (library text does the same, no token in sheet)
27:t_10:16: caption uses $$Ｄトレーダー$$ token instead of Jigoku literal 'D-Trader'
